# RentYourProperty.pk - Premier Rental Property Platform in Pakistan

> RentYourProperty.pk is Pakistan's dedicated online real estate rental platform, connecting property owners, landlords, and prospective tenants across Islamabad and Rawalpindi. Operated in association with **Next Avenue SMC Private Limited**.

## Overview & Core Purpose
RentYourProperty.pk is specifically focused on **property rentals** (houses, apartments, upper portions, lower portions, penthouses, commercial spaces, and offices). It provides transparent rental pricing, verified listings, digital landlord onboarding, and end-to-end tenant placement services.

- **Primary Website:** https://rentyourproperty.pk
- **Parent Company:** Next Avenue SMC Private Limited (https://www.nextavenuepk.com)
- **Primary Market:** Islamabad & Rawalpindi, Pakistan
- **Languages Supported:** English, Urdu

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. For Landlords & Property Owners
- **List Your Property for Rent:** Property owners can submit residential or commercial properties directly online.
- **Service & Commission:** Transparent 15-day rental commission (50% of 1 month's agreed rent) payable upon successful tenant placement.
- **Tenant Screening & Legal Support:** Assistance with police tenant registration (ICT Khidmat Markaz), CDA compliance, and 11-month tenancy agreements.
- **Listing URL:** https://rentyourproperty.pk/list-property

### 2. For Tenants & Renters
- **Search & Filter Rental Listings:** Direct search by Islamabad sector (e.g., F-6, F-7, F-8, F-10, F-11, G-11, E-11, DHA, Bahria Town), property type, budget, and bedrooms.
- **Direct Owner/Agent Communication:** Transparent details with no hidden brokerage fees.
- **Rentals Search URL:** https://rentyourproperty.pk/rent

### 3. Real Estate Insights & Guides
- Authoritative guides on Islamabad tenancy laws, CDA bylaws, police verification, rental yields, and sector comparison guides.
- **Blog URL:** https://rentyourproperty.pk/blog

## Key Sectors Covered in Islamabad
- **E-Sectors:** E-7, E-11
- **F-Sectors:** F-6, F-7, F-8, F-10, F-11
- **G-Sectors:** G-6, G-7, G-8, G-9, G-10, G-11, G-13
- **I-Sectors:** I-8, I-9, I-10
- **Master-Planned Communities:** DHA Islamabad (Phase 1, 2, 5), Bahria Town Islamabad/Rawalpindi, Gulberg Greens, B-17 Multi Gardens
